scripts.build:electron: bun build src/main/index.ts --outfile=dist/main.js --target=node --external electron --external electron-updater && bun build src/preload/index.ts --outfile=dist/preload.cjs --target=node --format=cjs --external electron && bun build src/preload/update.ts --outfile=dist/update-preload.cjs --target=node --format=cjs --external electron && bun build src/document/worker.ts --outfile=dist/worker.cjs --target=node --format=cjs
scripts.build:app: bun run build:ui && bun run build:electron && electron-builder --linux AppImage --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dev: bun run build:electron && OPENPENCIL_DEV=1 bash -c 'vite --config ui/vite.config.ts & pid=$!; trap "kill $pid" EXIT INT TERM; for _ in $(seq 1 50); do curl -sf -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:4179 && break; sleep 0.1; done; electron dist/main.js'
